title: [ORION-QG] qg3-positive-forecast has no green baseline: stage-1 exceeds the harness 120s capability timeout
body:
## Status

`orion-qg-qg3.yml` cannot pass on a GitHub-hosted runner, and has had **no green
baseline** — every other recent run of the workflow is `cancelled`.

## Symptom

Step *"Run stage 1 + dual-harness pre-ground-truth admission"* fails at
`development/orion-qg-regime-geometry/run_qg3_dual_harness.py:43`:

```
RuntimeError: local harness capability failed: <error>
```

The later `FileNotFoundError: artifacts/orion-qg-qg3-stage1.json` in the referee
step is downstream of this, not an independent fault.

## Diagnosis

`_run_local` requests the PYTHON capability with a hardcoded ceiling:

```python
request = workspace.get_or_create_request(
    capability="PYTHON", payload={"code": code, "cwd": ".", "timeout": 120}
)
```

and the code it runs is `research/extensions/orion-qg/qg3_stage1_select.py`.

Evidence:

- observed run: step started `2026-08-22T17:06:36Z`, raised at `17:08:37Z` —
  **121 s**, i.e. the 120 s ceiling plus overhead;
- running `qg3_stage1_select.py` directly on a local machine also exceeds 120 s.
  The exact runtime was **not** measured — two attempts were killed at the
  120 s mark — so the only firm statement is `> 120 s`.

## Why it was not seen before

The workflow sets

```yaml
concurrency:
  group: orion-qg-qg3-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
```

and every other recent run is on `claude/orion-harness-verification-b17qdj` with
conclusion `cancelled`. PR #926 is simply the first to let the workflow run to
completion, which is how the timeout surfaced. #926 adds only two scripts and
two result JSONs under `research/extensions/orion-qg/`, none imported or globbed
by the QG-3 harness; they match the workflow's `paths:` trigger and nothing more.

## Suggested repair (belongs to the QG-3 lane, not filed with a patch)

Either raise the `timeout` in `run_qg3_dual_harness.py` to cover the real
stage-1 runtime, or reduce stage-1's work. Whichever is chosen, the actual
runtime of `qg3_stage1_select.py` should be measured and recorded so the ceiling
is set from evidence rather than guessed.

Worth also asking whether `cancel-in-progress: true` is right for a protected
forecast workflow: it is what kept this defect invisible.

Found while running #926.

source.title: [ORION-QG] Land the QG-28..42 arc WITH its retraction — main must not stay ignorant of the null result
